items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 69:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the thirteen corrections of the beard of ZA? At the time ZA ascends to the GAR of AA, namely at twenty years, or on Shabbat at Mincha, then the lower beard of AA is included in the upper beard, and ZA acquires there thirteen corrections like the upper beard of AA, as above in Answer 68, see there. (Item 215).
